348: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
349:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
350: 
351:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
352: 
353:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
354: }
355: 
356: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
357:     predicate {
358:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
359:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
360: 
361:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
362:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
363:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
364: 
365:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
366:             &&& self.update.is_none()
367:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
368:         })
369: 
370:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
371:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
372:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
373:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
374:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
375: 
376:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
377:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
378:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
379:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
380:         })
381: 
382:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
383:             &&& self.update.is_none()
384:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
385:         })
386: 
387:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
388:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
389:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
390:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
391:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
392: 
393:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
394:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
395:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
396:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)
397:             &&& resp == update.value().get_Done_ret()
398:         })
399:     }
400: }
401: }

404: pub tracked struct FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
405:     pub tracked batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
406:     pub tracked cell_id: Ghost<CellId>,
407:     pub tracked local_updates: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>,
408:     pub tracked fc_clients: FlatCombiner::clients,
409: }
410: 
411: impl<DT: Dispatch> FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT> {
412:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_pre(
413:         &self,
414:         tid: nat,
415:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
416:         batch_cell: CellId,
417:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
418:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
419:     ) -> bool {
420:         &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
421:         &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
422:         &&& local_updates.value().is_Init()
423:         &&& local_updates.value().get_Init_op() == op
424:         &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
425:         &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
426:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
427:         &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
428:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
429:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
430:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
431:     }
432: 
433:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_post(&self, pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>) -> bool
434:         recommends
435:             pre.local_updates.is_some(),
436:     {
437:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
438:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0() == pre.local_updates.unwrap().key()
439:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
440:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
441:         &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
442:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
443:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
444:     }
445: 
446:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_pre(
447:         &self,
448:         batch_cell: CellId,
449:         tid: nat,
450:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
451:     ) -> bool {
452:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
453:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
454:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
455:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
456:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
457:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
458:     }
459: 
460:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_post(
461:         &self,
462:         pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>,
463:         ret: Option<DT::Response>,
464:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
465:     ) -> bool {
466:         &&& ret matches Some(ret) ==> {
467:             &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
468:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
469:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
470:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
471:             &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
472:             &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
473:             &&& local_updates.value().is_Done()
474:             &&& local_updates.key() == pre.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0()
475:             &&& local_updates.value().get_Done_ret() == ret
476:             &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
477:             &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
478:             &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
479:         }
480:         &&& ret.is_none() ==> {
481:             &&& self == pre
482:         }
483:     }
484: }
485: 
486: }

958:     pub(crate) fn get_version_upper_bound(
959:         &self,
960:         local_reads: Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>,
961:     ) -> (ret: (u64, Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>))
962:         requires
963:             self.wf(),
964:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
965:             local_reads@.value().is_Init(),
966:         ensures
967:             ret.1@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
968:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == ret.0 as nat,
969:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op() == local_reads@.value().get_Init_op(),
970:             ret.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
971:             ret.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
972:     {
973:         let tracked local_reads = local_reads.get();
974:         let ghost rid = local_reads.key();
975:         let tracked new_local_reads_g: UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>;
976:         let res =
977:             atomic_with_ghost!(
978:             &self.version_upper_bound.0 => load();
979:             returning res;
980:             ghost g => {
981:                 new_local_reads_g = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow()
982:                                             .readonly_version_upper_bound(rid, &g, local_reads);
983:             }
984:         );
985:         (res, Tracked(new_local_reads_g))
986:     }

1053:     pub fn append(

1062:             self.wf(),

1066:                 replica_token@,

1068:                 operations@,
1069:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1070:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,

1072:             operations.len() <= MAX_REQUESTS,

1078:                 operations@,
1079:                 final(responses)@,
1080:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,

1082:             ),

1086:         let nops = operations.len();
1087:         let mut iteration = 1;
1088:         let mut waitgc = 1;
1089:         loop
1090:             invariant
1091:                 self.wf(),
1092:                 0 <= waitgc <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1093:                 0 <= iteration <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1094:                 responses.len() == 0,
1095:                 replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1096:                 nid == replica_token@,

1842:     pub(crate) fn find_min_local_version(
1843:         &self,
1844:         cb_combiner: Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>,
1845:     ) -> (result: (u64, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>))
1846:         requires
1847:             self.wf(),
1848:             cb_combiner@.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1849:             cb_combiner@.value().is_Idle(),
1850:         ensures
1851:             result.0 <= MAX_IDX,
1852:             result.1@.key() == cb_combiner@.key(),
1853:             result.1@.value().is_AdvancingHead(),
1854:             result.1@.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1855:             result.1@.value().get_AdvancingHead_idx() == self.num_replicas,
1856:             result.1@.value().get_AdvancingHead_min_local_version() == result.0,
1857:     {
1858:         let num_replicas = self.local_versions.len();
1859:         let tracked mut g_cb_comb_new: CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT> = cb_combiner.get();
1860:         let ghost g_node_id = cb_combiner@.key();
1861:         let mut min_local_version =
1862:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1863:             &self.local_versions[0].0 => load();
1864:             returning ret;
1865:             ghost g => {
1866:                 g_cb_comb_new = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow()
1867:                                         .advance_head_start(g_node_id, &g.1, g_cb_comb_new);
1868:             });
1869:         let mut idx: usize = 1;
1870:         while idx < num_replicas
1871:             invariant
1872:                 self.wf(),
1873:                 0 <= idx <= num_replicas,
1874:                 min_local_version <= MAX_IDX,
1875:                 g_cb_comb_new.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1876:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().is_AdvancingHead(),
1877:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().get_AdvancingHead_idx() == idx,
1878:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().get_AdvancingHead_min_local_version() == min_local_version,
1879:                 g_cb_comb_new.key() == g_node_id,
1880:                 num_replicas == self.local_versions.len(),
1881:             decreases num_replicas - idx
1882:         {
1883:             let cur_local_tail =
1884:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1885:                 &self.local_versions[idx].0 => load();
1886:                 returning ret;
1887:                 ghost g => {
1888:                     g_cb_comb_new = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow()
1889:                                             .advance_head_next(g_node_id, &g.1, g_cb_comb_new);
1890:                 });
1891:             if cur_local_tail < min_local_version {
1892:                 min_local_version = cur_local_tail;
1893:             }
1894:             idx = idx + 1;
1895:         }
1896:         (min_local_version, Tracked(g_cb_comb_new))
1897:     }
1898: }
